subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom that can be substituted in the following sentence.

The robber __showed a clean pair of heels__ when the policeman came nearer.

options.text: stole and ran away with heels
stood so as to show the heels
showed how clean the heels were

solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4'** i.e. **'Ran away'.**
